services.recommendationsDesc: Compare three crop lenses with water, soil, yield, cost, and risk.
services.irrigationDesc: Protect every litre with zone-aware water planning.
services.profitDesc: Separate actual farm history from future scenarios.
services.weatherDesc: Prepare for drought, flood, rain, and field conditions.
services.memoryDesc: Use seasons, inputs, yields, and soil tests as farm memory.
services.schemesDesc: Review official links; eligibility is not confirmed.
services.marketDesc: See source-labelled market references, not fake buyers.
services.assistantDesc: Ask for a farmer-friendly explanation of structured results.

memory.title: The farm remembers the seasons.
memory.description: Use history to make the next recommendation more grounded. Every record is farmer-entered unless marked otherwise.
memory.missingHint: Test what is missing before interpreting a low-confidence score.

recommendations.title: Choose with context, not just yield.
recommendations.description: The recommendation engine compares rotation, water, season, soil context, yield, cost, and price. It never changes the actual planted crop.
recommendations.notice: Numerical outputs are deterministic decision-support estimates. Validate crop-specific constraints with local agronomy before planting.
recommendations.restoreText: Favour rotation and resilience when the indicator is low or the previous crop creates a rotation opportunity.
recommendations.balancedText: Prefer a season-fit choice without optimizing one number at the expense of field context.
recommendations.profitText: Compare expected profit while retaining water, season, and carry-over risk warnings.
recommendations.noDecisions: Accept or reject a recommendation to create a farmer decision record.
recommendations.explanation: Review assumptions before acting. The planted crop remains unchanged.

monitor.title: Protect every litre.
monitor.description: Separate measured conditions, the three-day water planning proxy, irrigation advice, and climate risk. Pumps are never controlled automatically.
monitor.weatherNote: Demonstration forecast only; no live weather integration is claimed.
monitor.readingsNote: Sensor values are labelled by source; simulated values are not live readings.
monitor.noReadings: No sensor readings have been recorded.
monitor.staleNote: Stale readings are flagged; failed readings are never replaced with fake values.
monitor.safety: Decision support only; farmer confirmation and hardware safety interlock required.
monitor.riskSignal: No claim of accurate future prediction; risk is a preparedness signal.
monitor.formula: Water budget = available water − projected irrigation demand

profit.title: Know the range before you commit.
profit.description: Actual history is kept separate from estimates. Future profit is a scenario, not guaranteed income.
profit.formula: Revenue = harvest quantity × selling price. Profit = revenue − recorded cultivation expenses.
profit.noRecords: Add season records to see cost categories.

market.title: Sell with the source visible.
market.description: No fake buyers, transactions, live prices, or confirmed scheme eligibility are created.
market.marketNotice: Demonstration market data. Connect a verified mandi feed before using prices for a sale decision.
market.schemeNote: Official links are provided for verification; eligibility is not confirmed and no application is submitted.

assistant.title: Ask the system to explain the numbers.
assistant.description: The fallback explains structured decision-engine results. It does not invent sensor readings, weather, prices, yields, or profits, and it is not NeuGen inference.
assistant.tryAsk: Try asking: “Why is the water budget in deficit?”
assistant.placeholder: Ask about water, soil, crop choice, risk, or profit…
suggestions: Why is the water budget in deficit?

forms.readingNotice: This form records a farmer-entered test reading. ESP32 submissions must explicitly use LIVE_SENSOR after device authentication is configured.

admin.reviewNetwork: Review the farm network with care.
admin.demoGate: This MVP admin surface requires an explicit admin role header. Production should replace the demo gate with verified Manus OAuth role claims and farmer-record authorization.
admin.demoOnly: Demo mode only. This does not create a production administrator account.
admin.overviewTitle: One view of the farm network.
admin.overviewDescription: Monitor farmers, farms, zones, devices, alerts, and decision history without silently changing farmer-owned records.
admin.coverageDesc: Live-looking values remain labelled by source.
admin.registryDesc: Offline and stale devices should be investigated, not replaced with synthetic readings.
admin.alertsDesc: Review queue for the farm support team.
admin.decisionsDesc: Farmer decisions are reviewable and are not overwritten by recommendations.
admin.analyticsDesc: A compact view of connectivity, alert load, and mapped field coverage.
